data.body: **P2:** `_closing` is checked only before this child-start task is submitted. If shutdown begins while the task is running, `_start_child_execution` can still persist a child and submit work after the execution registry and scheduler have been stopped, resurrecting lanes or leaving a partially launched child. Recheck shutdown state inside the mutating task and reject registry/scheduler submissions after shutdown, or drain this bounded work before closing; add a test that blocks child creation while `close()` runs.
